The '''Crystal Jewel''' was a squalid<ref name="EGTD" /> [[Casino/Legends|casino]] in the [[Southern Underground/Legends|Southern Underground]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The sign for the establishment read "''If the customers don't kill you, the drinks will''".<ref>[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]</ref> [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] won the deed to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] in a [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] game with [[Omogg]]<ref name="Courtship">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref> at the Crystal Jewel when it had operated under a different name<ref name="TNR">''[[The New Rebellion]]''</ref> in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Solo went there again in [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]] to meet with [[Jarril]], a former smuggling associate of his.<ref name="TNR" /> The casino employed a [[LeisureMech Enterprises/Legends|LeisureMech]] [[RH7 CardShark]] [[Dealer droid/Legends|Automated sabacc dealer droid]].<ref name="EGTD" />
